title: Add the anchor step, worker return shape and self-check to Trace and Provenance sweep
action: Adopt the L4 practices into the one home of both procedures (per D2 and D4), translated into bee's words, never pasted. Never rename, re-level or delete an existing heading; add sub-steps and lines inside the existing sections. Do NOT run bee dev regen (wave-barrier). Changes: (1) Trace step 1 and a new first Provenance step: when the target is vague, write your reading as the first line of the account and go on, never stop to ask. (2) Provenance sweep gains an Anchor step before its rows: write the path:line range, the symbols and a few search terms; run `git blame -L <a>,<b> <path>` for the commits that last touched the lines and take PR numbers from their subjects; every row searches those terms. (3) Trace step 3: brief each worker with the question as a path, its one entry point, and a fixed return shape — ordered steps with path:line and what each calls next, boundaries, surprises, UNFOLLOWED steps with reason, files read. (4) Trace step 5: when two returns disagree on a step, open that anchor and settle it; if the code does not settle it, name the disagreement under Gotchas. (5) Provenance row 2 (git history): read back to the first commit, not the last; skip bot commits; for a copied pattern, find and read where it first appeared. (6) After the seven rows: when the target is defensive (a guard, retry, timeout, sleep or flag), add revert, hotfix, incident and the error string to the git and tracker search terms. (7) When git history or the tracker returns more than a screen of hits, fan that row alone through the dispatch door as a gather with the anchor; keep the other rows inline. (8) Phrasing rules gain two bullets: before calling a claim Supported, ask whether the evidence would look different if the reading were wrong, and if not it is Inferred; evidence about a neighbour feature never answers a question about this one. (9) Provenance answer shape: open with Question and anchor (the question in one sentence, then the path:line range and symbols); What we do not know names who would likely know (the commit author, the decision owner); end with a short self-check before sending (every found claim has its source beside it; tier words match the tier; no claim uses the code as its own reason; the guess in the question was checked; the gap section names a gap or says why there is none). (10) Trace answer shape: when a step is complex say why it is complex, when it is simple give it one line. Prefer words over a new numeric limit.
